title: Registration — Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB 2027
publisher: UTMB World Series / Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB
claims: The registration page gives 2027 race dates of 22–25 April 2027, while the races page gives 23–26 April 2027.
The 2027 all-in prices are $437.37 for the 100K, $568.76 for the 100M, $311.76 for the 50K and $177.67 for the 25K.
Registration is non-refundable and non-transferable, with a one-time for-any-reason deferral to the next year available until 24 March 2027; there is no waiting list and no race-day registration.
The minimum age is 18 for the 100M, 100K and 50K and 16 for the 25K.
The 100M and 100K are Western States qualifiers for 2028, requiring finishes under 35 hours and 20 hours respectively.

The 100K Super Golden Ticket gives the top three female and male finishers entry to the 2027 Western States, passing down if a recipient is already qualified or declines, with no runner below fifth offered the ticket.
All finishers collect Running Stones, and the Finals lottery requires at least one stone and a valid UTMB Index.
